description: Check a domain's registration expiry (via WHOIS) and DNS health: nameservers, A/AAAA, MX, SPF, and DMARC records. Flags common misconfigurations. WHOIS + DNS only — for the WHOIS record alone use whois_lookup; for deliverability detail (DKIM, DNSBL, PTR) use email_deliverability_check; for all of it plus SEO in one report use domain_report.

domain.description: Bare domain to check, e.g. example.com (no scheme/path)

name: domain_health_check
